question.prompt: Walking 12 kilometers takes the same amount of time as cycling 36 kilometers. The cycling speed is 8 kilometers per hour faster than the walking speed. Let the walking speed be \(x\) kilometers per hour. Which equation models this situation?

solutions.explanation: The walking time is \(\frac{12}{x}\). The cycling speed is \(x+8\), and the cycling time is \(\frac{36}{x+8}\). Equating the times gives \(\frac{12}{x}=\frac{36}{x+8}\).
solutions.title: Express and equate the travel times
